before_conditions: The gauge contract holds reward tokens for liquidity providers.
The reward token is the same as token0 or token1 of the CL pool.
The _claimFees function is callable by anyone via the public claimFees function.
The _claimFees function calculates collected fees by checking the contract's total balance of token0 and token1 after calling clPool.collectFees().
required_property: Reward tokens held in the gauge for liquidity providers must not be treated as trading fees and must remain available for liquidity providers to claim.
bad_outcome: Anyone can call claimFees() and drain the gauge's reward token balance, sending it to the internal_bribe contract, stealing rewards from liquidity providers and causing subsequent reward claims to fail.
